note: All models below were verified live against provider catalogs on 2026-09-30. Free tiers change often — run `freeload doctor` to re-verify.

plan.description: Architecture, reasoning, debugging strategy — hardest tasks go to the biggest free models first

edit.description: Small fast edits, renames, single-file fixes

chat.description: Titles, summaries, Q&A, trivial calls — cheapest first

on: No endpoints found that support tool use
fallback.strategy: Advance to the next model in the class chain. Never retry the same model twice for the same error. If a chain is exhausted, drop one class level (plan->code->edit->chat) and continue. Only escalate to a paid model when the user explicitly allows it.
